title: No Thoughts Just AI: Biased LLM Hiring Recommendations Alter Human Decision Making and Limit Human Autonomy
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The study focuses on measuring how biased AI hiring recommendations alter human decision-making, specifically in the context of racial bias (White vs. Black, Asian, or Hispanic candidates).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The findings are centered on how human hiring decisions are significantly influenced by racially biased AI recommendations, often leading to the propagation of the AI's bias, and how interventions like Implicit Association Tests (IATs) can slightly mitigate this effect.
